name: Piyush Tatrari
summary: Full Stack Engineer with **2+ years of experience** at CustomerInsights.AI, working on **ciATHENA**, an agentic AI platform for pharma commercial teams. Built the interface for its first use cases as a Junior Data Engineer; since the promotion to Associate Full Stack Engineer, owns those use cases across frontend and backend and delivers them for several pharma clients. Works in **React.js**, **Next.js**, **TypeScript**, **Python** and **FastAPI**, builds **agentic AI**, **RAG** and **LLM** features with **LangChain** and **LangGraph**, and uses **GitHub Actions**, **Docker** and **Azure** for delivery. **Employee of the Quarter** in 2025 and 2026.

experience.title: Associate Full Stack Engineer
experience.lead: ciATHENA: full-stack ownership of the pharma use cases. Employee of the Quarter, September 2026.
points: Own ciATHENA's core use cases (**MMM**, **FAST**, **Payer Spine**, **Data Stewardship** and others) across the **React.js** and **TypeScript** screens and the **Python** and **FastAPI** services behind them, and deliver them for separate pharma clients, each with its own data and features.

Build the backend for **Field Intelligence** and the **agentic AI** features around it: agent configuration screens, the service that stores and runs each agent, and **LangChain** and **LangGraph** workflows that pause for a person's approval before the agent acts.
Build the **LLM** and **RAG** layer: **embeddings** and a **vector database** for semantic search, so users can ask questions in plain language and get answers from their own data.
Own the backend for the data-mapping and review workflows (schema and entity review, mapping, batch approvals) on **PostgreSQL** and **Snowflake**.

Design the system with the team: a configuration-driven backend, so a new client or use case needs setup rather than a rebuild; services that scale; and results streamed to the UI over **Server-Sent Events** (**system design**).
Develop the ongoing-threads, collaboration and insights hub modules, with **ECharts** charts and **Zustand** state.
Implement **CI/CD** in **GitHub Actions**, run services in **Docker** on **Azure**, and test with **Jest** and **pytest**. Track work in **Jira**.

experience.title: Junior Data Engineer

points: Built the interface for ciATHENA's first 5–6 use cases, including **MMM**, **FAST**, **Payer Spine** and **Data Stewardship**, from logic described by pharma business experts.
Built **Field Intelligence** in the ciATHENA hub, including the **MyDay** and **District View** screens and their charts, in **React.js**, **Next.js** and **TypeScript**.
Built the conversational analytics interface with streaming **Server-Sent Events (SSE)**, ongoing threads, session restore and duplicate-request guards.
Built **10+ reusable components** that the use cases share, and fixed an **ECharts** bug that recovered **11 product series across** **21 months**, with **14 regression tests**.
Shipped features for **4 client-facing products** (**LENS**, **TPA**, **CORE**, **Patient Flow**) with REST API integration and responsive layouts.
Wrote **Jest** unit tests, ran QA across full user flows, and refactored **5+ modules**.
